metaDescription: Distillation's feature set as specced: recipe discovery at the stand, the missing brews, batch brewing, honest durations and draughts, premium potions, antidotes, and rebalanced thrown potions.
title: Features
lede: The seven headline systems, as specced in design/SPEC.md. Distillation is in development — these are commitments, not yet a shipped jar.

sections.title: Brew by Discovery
sections.intro: The stand teaches its own recipes — no wiki required.

html: Hold an ingredient over the stand's ingredient slot and the vapor clouds with a color hint of what it would become; once you know a recipe, the hint names the output outright. A failed combination still bottles: a Murky Draught whose tooltip names one ingredient that would have worked with that base — a failure that teaches. Every successful brew you take from the stand is written permanently into your recipes page, right in the brewing screen, with a running count that gilds when you have learned them all.

Discovery is per player and survives death and relog. Recipe viewers (EMI/REI/JEI) show only what you've discovered by default, so they never spoil what the stand wants to teach — a server can open them up, or start everyone fully unlocked.

sections.title: The Missing Brews
sections.intro: Every vanilla effect that shipped without a recipe becomes brewable.

blocks.note: Haste routes through Swiftness deliberately — honey over a sugar brew. Fermented spider eye corrupts Haste into Mining Fatigue and Luck into Bad Luck; all five lines take gunpowder and dragon's breath as usual.

sections.title: Batch Brewing
sections.intro: Recipes you have discovered scale past three bottles.

html: Set your brewing stand on a water cauldron heated from below — a lit campfire or soul campfire, fire or soul fire, a lava source, or a magma block — and the stand's screen grows a second row of three bottle slots. Brewing a recipe from your recipes page fills all six bottles in one pass, consuming 3 ingredients (against 2 for two normal passes — the 1.5× cost), 2 fuel charges, and 1 water level from the cauldron.
The shortcut is earned: bottles whose recipe you haven't discovered are skipped untouched, hoppers can neither see nor fill the batch row, and an automated stand never batch-brews.

sections.title: Honest Durations & Draughts
sections.intro: Durations sized to how people actually play, and potions drinkable in halves.

html: Utility potions stop expiring in transit: Fire Resistance, Water Breathing, Night Vision, and Invisibility base at 8:00 instead of 3:00 (20:00 extended), and Slow Falling at 4:00. Combat potions — Strength, Swiftness, Poison, and the rest — keep their short vanilla timers.
Sneak-drink any duration potion to sip half: 4:00 of an 8:00 potion now, and the bottle stays in your hand as a stoppered half for later. Drinking the half returns the glass bottle as usual.

sections.title: Premium Brews
sections.intro: Redstone and glowstone stop being mutually exclusive.

html: Brew a potion's own reagent onto it a second time — two blaze powder total for Strength — and it becomes Concentrated: identical stats, a deeper liquid, and a Concentrated tag. A concentrated potion then accepts both dusts, in either order, and comes out extended and amplified.
On an ordinary potion the dusts behave exactly as in vanilla, so nothing you already know changes. Only effects with a level II form can be concentrated.

blocks.note: A premium potion runs at its strong level for half its extended duration. Concentration is a graph conversion like any other — hintable, discoverable, and murkable; concentrating a no-strong-form or already-modified potion is an invalid pair. Setting enablePremiumBrews to false removes the concentration steps while existing bottles keep working.

sections.title: Antidotes
sections.intro: Surgical cures, brewed from the affliction's own source.

blocks.note: Each strips exactly one effect and nothing else — your 8-minute buffs stay. Milk is untouched and still clears everything. Antidotes throw as splash and lingering, so a cleansing cloud is a real support play.

sections.title: Lingering Worth Throwing
sections.intro: Splash and lingering potions rebalanced as support tools.

html: Lingering clouds last 60 seconds instead of 30 and open at a 4½-block radius instead of 3. A splash potion applies 87.5% of the drinkable duration instead of 75%. Throw a cloud where the fight is and it is still working when the second wave arrives — a dedicated brewer becomes a viable support role.

sections.title: Better Together
sections.intro: With siblings from the Concord collection installed, Distillation lights up further — never required, and with none installed nothing is missing.

items: Tribulation — the afflictions its hardened mobs inflict gain brewable antidotes made from the shard items themselves.
Mercantile — the cleric's stock deepens with your reputation: rare brewing reagents for emeralds.
Prosperity — far-tier chests turn up reagents you have never held over a stand.
